Frequently asked questions

Which regulations do these courses follow?
  • Mold Prevention and Remediation Awareness Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA and EPA Guidelines.
  • Mold Awareness, Prevention, and Remediation Training for Property Management Teams: in accordance with Federal OSHA and EPA Guidelines, Best Practice Recommendations by the AIHA, and IAC2 Mold Inspection Standards of Practice.
  • Mold Inspector Certification for Prevention, Remediation, and Removal Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA and EPA Guidelines, and IAC2 Mold Inspection Standards of Practice.
How long does Mold Inspector Certification & Remediation Training take?
  • Mold Prevention and Remediation Awareness Training: 2 hours.
  • Mold Awareness, Prevention, and Remediation Training for Property Management Teams: 4 hours.
  • Mold Inspector Certification for Prevention, Remediation, and Removal Training: 6 hours.

Training is self-paced, so you can stop and pick up where you left off at any time.

How long do I have to finish?

You get a 3-month completion timeline, 1-year access to training materials.

Do I get a certificate?

Yes. You can download your certificate of completion as soon as you pass the final exam.

  • Mold Prevention and Remediation Awareness Training: valid 36 months
  • Mold Awareness, Prevention, and Remediation Training for Property Management Teams: valid 24 months
  • Mold Inspector Certification for Prevention, Remediation, and Removal Training: valid 36 months
Can I take the training on my phone?

Yes. The training is 100% online and works on phones, tablets and computers, 24 hours a day.

Can I buy training for my whole team?

Yes. Enter the number of seats at checkout. Team pricing starts at 2 seats and goes up to 10% off for 501–1,000 seats. For larger orders or invoicing, call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

Is the training available in Spanish?

Yes. All 3 courses are available in English and Spanish.

How do I start my course after I pay?

Right after checkout you'll get an email with your receipt and your login for the learning portal. Sign in at hazwoper-osha.com to begin.

Who provides the training?

Courses are delivered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC on its online learning portal at hazwoper-osha.com. Questions? Call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

What is the refund policy?

See the refund policy on hazwoper-osha.com, or call us before you start a course.
